scenes.eyebrow: For the branch manager and the unit managers
scenes.headline: The board, for management
scenes.sub: Every household, every agent, and how fast each client converts
scenes.line: This is the client transition board, as the branch manager and the unit managers see it. Every household, every agent, and how fast each client converts.

scenes.headline: Your number, your password
scenes.line: Open Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash orphan management, on a phone or a laptop. Sign in with your agent number, or your first name, and your password. The device keeps you signed in until you press Sign out.

scenes.headline: Urgent opens first
scenes.line: You open on Urgent. First, the call-backs Client Support asked for. Then the clients who want an agent now, or who say a former agent has been in touch.

scenes.headline: The whole picture, at a glance
scenes.line: The Agents tab shows the whole picture. How many households have an agent. How many answered, and are still waiting. And how far each agent has got.

scenes.headline: Conversations and conversion
scenes.line: Each agent has one line. Conversations. Converted, which means met or completed. And how many days their clients have waited. A client named two working days ago, with nothing logged, turns red.

scenes.headline: The first two days matter most
scenes.line: Since the naming shows every client by how long ago they were named. The aim is a conversation in the first two days, and a meeting soon after.

scenes.headline: In batches, most pressing first
scenes.line: Below are the households still to name, in batches. Urgent first. Then families where one member already has an agent. Then everyone who asked us for something.

scenes.headline: The family stays together
scenes.line: Each household carries one suggested agent, so a family stays together. One press names the whole household. Or name a whole batch at once.

scenes.headline: Every move on record
scenes.line: To move a client, choose Reassign. The history keeps every agent, the date, and who made the change, on the board or in Salesforce.

scenes.headline: What happens next

rows.b: The agent gets a brief by e-mail
rows.i: every client named to them, with what each one told us

rows.b: The client is on the agent's own list
rows.i: the moment the name is given on the board

rows.b: A name given in Salesforce reaches the board

scenes.line: When a client is named, the agent gets a brief by e-mail, and the client appears on the agent's own list. A name given in Salesforce reaches the board within fifteen minutes.

scenes.headline: Your own team
scenes.line: A unit manager sees their own team. Each agent's line, their clients and their conversations, and how long each client has waited.

scenes.headline: Name the household. Watch the days. Convert the client.
scenes.line: Name the household. Watch the days. Convert the client.
